source.title: Delegate accidentally reused scrambles from previous competition
source.content:
The delegate of [ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ERAUSpeedcubingSpring2018) accidentally used scrambles from a prior competition ([STEM Educ8 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/STEMEduc82018)) for multiple rounds of this competition. These scrambles have been publicly accesible since the results of the earlier competition were published.

The WRC has decided that all affected results of ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018 will not be accepted as official WCA results. These are: 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx and Square-1.
Accordingly, only the results of Megaminx and 7x7x7 Cube will be recognized.

We know that this is a harsh decision with consequences for many young competitors. However, the integrity of scrambles in WCA competitions is essential and does not allow us to be lenient here.

translation.title: 代表意外重复使用先前比赛的打乱
translation.content:
[ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ERAUSpeedcubingSpring2018) 的代表在本场比赛多个轮次中，意外使用了先前比赛 [STEM Educ8 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/STEMEduc82018) 的打乱。这些打乱在前一场比赛成绩公布后已可公开获取。

WRC 决定，不接受 ERAU Speedcubing Spring 2018 所有受影响成绩为 WCA 正式成绩，涉及二阶、三阶、四阶、三阶单手、金字塔及 Square-1。因此，只有五魔方和七阶的成绩得到认可。

我们知道，这一严厉决定会影响许多年轻选手。然而，WCA 比赛打乱的完整性至关重要，在此不能宽免。
